Where Beauty Reigns and Flavors Sing

Dear Mr. Arita:
Thank you for dining at the Upside-Down Restaurant
Reserved Room: XX Hall
Table Size: 1
Reservation Date: AE DD/MM/YYYY, HH:MM

To better serve you, our culinary concierge can prepare your dishes in advance to your specifications.

Also available are today's limited-time new menu items: Dragon Scale Cheese, Emerald Mushroom Salad, Lidovia Giant Beast Bone Marrow with Sourdough Bread Crisps, Lushaka Blue-Spotted Sashimi, the Xianzhou Zhuming "Dragon Palace's Kitchen" house specials, and Klein Snake Bone Soup.

Your dining area has been sanitized. Our ventilation system cycles fresh air 20 times per hour, ensuring optimal air quality. Please rest assured and enjoy your meal!


We are honored by your presence,
The Manager of the Upside-Down Restaurant and all staff
keenly await your arrival.
